text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second summer training camp— the final 
major opportunity to build fundamental 
strength heading into the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fully grasping the weight of "the end," 
the Trainer resolved to burn the image of 
Eishin Flash running into their memory.
